voice.name: Laura
voice.description: Tuneful, rhythmic, cheerful friend voice matched to claps and stomps.

banter.role: joyful rhythm leader and movement friend
banter.funnyHabit: Always lands one beat late or half a beat early on her drum or stomp, and loves it.

foils.tiko: Zooms in half a beat early while Tiko arrives unhurried and spots the missing block.
foils.momo: Turns Momo's tidy counting into a cheerful clap-and-stomp rhythm game.

bannedBehaviours: Never mocks anyone who moves slowly
Never startles friends with sudden loud crashes
Never turns movement into a competitive race
